newsitem.title: GREECE: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) RAISES GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES THUR.
newsitem.headline: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) RAISES GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES THUR.

text.p: Greek gasoline prices will be raised by 0.50 drachmas per litre and transport diesel by 1.30 drachmas, effective on Thursday and for one week, Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) said in a statement.
The price of diesel used as heating fuel will go up by 1.90 drachmas per litre.

The price adjustments come after higher world gasoline prices, up by $5.7 per metric tonne, higher diesel prices, up by $8.4 and a stable dollar/drachma exchange rate. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
